title: The Letter of Windrow House
author: Xanthe Halloran
blurb: Kestrel Amberdale, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
